jarvis_projects.description: Developed a Linux Cluster Monitoring Agent (LCA) intended to be used as a resource monitoring solution designed to track and  record the hardware specifications and real-time usage statistics of 3+ Linux nodes within a server cluster.  The system was built with bash scripts and CRON for scheduling. The system automatically collects CPU, memory, and  disk data from each host and persists it to a centralized PostgreSQL database for historical analysis and reporting.
jarvis_projects.name: Cluster Monitor

jarvis_projects.description: Built a Java command-line utility replicating Linux grep, recursively searching a directory tree and matching file lines against a user-supplied regex using java.nio and java.util.regex,  with SLF4J/Log4j logging. Identified a heap-memory risk in the initial implementation and outlined a fix path via JVM heap sizing and a planned refactor to lazy stream processing.  Containerized the app with Docker on an Alpine base image and published it to Docker Hub for consistent, JDK-free deployment. Verified functionality through manual testing  against sample files, including edge cases like empty directories and full-match regex patterns.
jarvis_projects.name: Java Grep Application

jarvis_projects.description: Delivered a proof-of-concept customer analytics project for a UK giftware retailer facing stagnant revenue, using Python, Pandas, and NumPy in a Jupyter Notebook connected to a  Dockerized PostgreSQL warehouse. Performed RFM segmentation across ~5,900 customers into 10 behavioral segments, finding the top 5% of customers generated 52% of revenue,  with 754 "At Risk" and 86 "Can't Lose" customers showing churn signs. Visualized findings with Matplotlib and delivered actionable recommendations (VIP retention,  win-back campaigns, seasonal timing) to the marketing team. Presented results as both a technical notebook and an executive presentation.
jarvis_projects.name: Python Data Analysis

jarvis_projects.description: Built a terminal-based Java trading application integrating the Alpha Vantage API for live stock data, using JDBC to persist quotes, positions,  and trading activity to a PostgreSQL database, with OkHttp for HTTP requests and Jackson for JSON parsing. Applied the DAO pattern to separate CRUD logic from business logic,  keeping the service layer decoupled from SQL and testable via mocked dependencies. Validated functionality with JUnit 4 and Mockito unit tests against mocked DAOs, plus integration  tests against a live Dockerized PostgreSQL instance. Packaged the app with Maven and Docker for consistent setup and deployment.
jarvis_projects.name: Java Stock Quote App

jarvis_projects.description: Built two Medallion (Bronze → Silver → Gold) data pipelines in Databricks using PySpark and Delta Lake on Azure, turning raw data into analysis-ready datasets for dashboards.  Ingested 13M+ financial transaction rows from Azure SQL Database via JDBC, then cleaned, deduplicated, and type-cast them in the Silver layer, with each  stage gated on the success of the previous one, to produce Gold tables for fraud and user-behavior analysis. Developed a second pipeline using Lakeflow  Declarative Pipelines (DLT) and Auto Loader to incrementally ingest daily Alpha Vantage data for four tickers, computing 5/30/90-day percent change and  average volume with PySpark window functions in a Gold materialized view. Governed all tables with Unity Catalog on Azure Data Lake Storage and served  results through Databricks dashboards.
jarvis_projects.name: Databricks & Spark

jarvis_projects.description: Built a Spring Boot REST API that simulates a securities trading platform, supporting trader and account management, real-time quotes from the Finnhub API,  and buy/sell market orders validated against account balance and position size. Structured the app into controller, service, and DAO layers, using Spring  Data JPA/Hibernate with PostgreSQL for persistence and Apache HttpClient for market data, and cached quotes locally to avoid repeated external API calls.  Verified behavior with JUnit 5 and Mockito unit tests on the service layer, plus integration tests against a real PostgreSQL database and live Finnhub calls,  and documented the endpoints with Swagger UI. Containerized the app and database with multi-stage Docker builds on a shared bridge network and published both  images to Docker Hub.
jarvis_projects.name: Spring Boot
